recent_excerpts: Canada's Cyber Centre warns CVE-2026-48842, a CVSS 8.1 pre-auth SQL injection in Roundcube's virtuser_query plugin, is being exploited. Fixed in 1.6.16 and 1.7.1.
CISA added CVE-2026-65660, a network-exploitable SharePoint code injection flaw, to its KEV catalog with a 2026-09-28 federal remediation deadline.
CISA added CVE-2025-39682, a 9.8-CVSS Linux kernel TLS receive-path flaw, to its KEV catalog after evidence of active exploitation in the wild.
